issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print Actual on GAAP Basis, Adjustments, Actual on Budgetary Basis, Original and Final Budget
issues.issue: Detail amounts use the GAAP-basis actual column (ties to p2), but budget_final is on the budgetary basis, so actual vs budget compares different bases (e.g. General Fund Warrants Issued GAAP 0 vs budgetary 77,718 vs budget 88,300). This is a defensible choice and the notes explain it.
